module.purpose: Selects the Plain chat component dynamically when its public environment configuration is present, otherwise providing a React fragment fallback.
module.summary: This module is a small environment-driven binding for the web application's Plain chat integration. It reads a public build-time configuration value and conditionally exposes a lazily loaded chat component through Next.js dynamic loading, falling back to an empty React fragment when chat is not configured.
module.businessContext: Supports optional customer chat in the web application. If configuration or loading behavior fails, chat is unavailable while the rest of the application can still render.

io: Lazily loads the Plain chat module through the framework's dynamic import mechanism when the configured branch is rendered.

sectionMap.name: chat-provider-selection
sectionMap.intent: Select the dynamically loaded chat component or an empty fragment fallback.

publicSignatures.name: default
publicSignatures.signature: export default process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_PLAIN_CHAT_ID ? dynamic(() => import("./plainChat")) : Fragment;

edgeCases.behavior: Exports Fragment instead of attempting to load the Plain chat module.
Exports a Next.js dynamic component that imports ./plainChat lazily.

invariants.description: The default export is always either the dynamically loaded chat binding or the React fragment fallback.

assumptions.description: The build or runtime environment supplies NEXT_PUBLIC_PLAIN_CHAT_ID when Plain chat should be enabled.
Consumers treat the default export as a renderable React component or component-like binding.

concurrencyModel.notes: Module selection is synchronous and deterministic; the selected chat module is loaded asynchronously by Next.js when needed.
